label: Good
corporate_parent: GE Appliances — subsidiary of Haier Group (acquired 2016)
manufacturing_location: Multiple US factories including facilities in Kentucky and Georgia. Selmer, Tennessee (Monogram Refrigeration LLC — premium refrigeration, not gas ranges).

burner_system.description: Standard sealed burners — no pro-style dual-stacked or open burner differentiation. 18K BTU max on primary burner. No genuine commercial heritage.
burner_system.supplier: Sabaf OEM probable — standard commodity sealed burners

grate_system.description: Individual cast iron grates — standard, not continuous

construction.body: Residential-style slide-in construction — cosmetic pro-style, not genuine commercial-derived
construction.positioning: Mid-luxury GE line positioned between Profile and Monogram. Premium aesthetics (customizable hardware finishes) over genuine build quality differentiation.
construction.source_traceability: Multi-source identified — shared platform across GE family

oven_convection.description: True European convection on premium Café models (dedicated ring element + fan). Some models may be fan-assisted only — model-specific.

performance_evidence.simmer_detail: Standard sealed burner simmer — not competitive with Wolf 500 BTU or Thermador ExtraLow
performance_evidence.oven_temp_uniformity: 8-12°F estimated — acceptable but not premium benchmark
performance_evidence.boil_time: good — 18K BTU is standard for the segment

yale_service_rate.context: CRITICAL: 11.7% is above 6.9% category average. Base GE is 4.8%, Profile is 10.1%, Café is 11.7%. The 'premium' line is LESS reliable than base GE by 2.4x.
yale_service_rate.hypothesis: Higher service rate attributed to increased electronic complexity: double oven configurations, WiFi, smart connectivity, digital interfaces, convection modes, air fry — more potential failure points than simpler base models.

common_failures.control_board: Control board failures frequently reported — electronic components fail, causing non-responsive interfaces or erratic behavior (beeping, display errors).
common_failures.igniters: Oven igniter failure is commonly cited — parts wear out over time or get fouled by food residue.
common_failures.convection_systems: Convection fans face more wear from added modes (convection baking, air fry).

igniter_type.description: Silicon carbide — commodity. #1 repair part. Not upgraded to silicon nitride.

service_network.description: GE's OWNED national service network — the strongest service ecosystem in the entire appliance industry. This is Café's single strongest durability attribute. Fast response times, universal parts, expert technicians.

parts_availability.description: Universal parts availability — broadest in the industry. OEM and aftermarket readily available.

control_board.notes: Documented control board issues — more electronic features = more failure points.

safety_evidence.recalls: None identified for current GE Café gas range models
safety_evidence.gas_emissions: NO₂ non-differentiated by brand — ventilation is the intervention

platform_disclosure.ge_selmer_platform: MANDATORY: GE Café shares significant internal components, engineering platforms, and manufacturing facilities with Monogram, Profile, and base GE. Differentiated primarily by 'trim levels' — aesthetics, features, and finish — not internal engineering. Internal parts diagrams for convection systems or heating elements may be identical across lines.
platform_disclosure.reliability_anomaly: CRITICAL FINDING: Base GE (4.8%) is MORE reliable than Café (11.7%). This 2.4x gap within the SAME corporate family suggests feature complexity (smart connectivity, digital interfaces) is the primary driver of service calls — not manufacturing quality.
platform_disclosure.haier_ownership: GE Appliances acquired by Haier Group in 2016. Manufacturing and sourcing changes since acquisition are ongoing.

corrections.original_value: Selmer TN factory shared platform for gas ranges
corrections.corrected_value: Selmer TN (Monogram Refrigeration LLC) is premium REFRIGERATION, not gas range production. Gas ranges manufactured at other GE facilities (KY, GA). Platform sharing still applies across GE family but Selmer TN is not the gas range factory.
corrections.reason: Deep dive clarified Selmer TN focuses on refrigeration, not cooking.

S: Yale Appliance — gas range service rate 11.7%
